business_summary: AI storm Co., Ltd. provides IT consulting services in Japan. The company offers implementation consulting services, including post-implementation business improvement, pre-implementation business analysis and business improvement, project management, support and consulting, responses to legal reforms, contracting for development of add-ons and modifications, overseas to domestic expansion, and operational support; and version upgrade services, such as new hardware design, procurement and installation of new hardware, pre-installation of software, current resource migration, host name change, upgrade installation, backup settings, operation verification, identifying repair targets and estimating repair work hours, program development, unit and integration testing, modification of existing systems, differential training, user acceptance testing, revision of business and operation manuals, data migration rehearsal, final data transfer, and post-operational follow up services. It also provides JDE Oracle Cloud Migration Omakase Pack, provides cloudification diagnosis to system configuration design, migration work, and oracle cloud contracts; and operation trouble resolution, avoidance, repair, investigation, application, and setting change support services, as well as guidance and support for parameter changes, suggestions introduction of other cases and support, and holding regular operation meetings. In addition, the company offers archive solutions; and implementation consulting, oracle cloud migration pack, version upgrade services, and archive solutions. Further, it provides NetSuite training, workflow construction, FB data creation operational support, and excel integration; CSOD implementation consulting; schedule synchronization implementation support; and LED VISION sales and rental, as well as provides installation and maintenance of LED VISION and creating content for LED VISION. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
